text: {"question":"How does the inclusion of a fluidlike light relic affect the inferred Hubble constant and matter fraction when combining CMB and DESI data?","reference_answer":"Adding a fluidlike light relic raises the Hubble constant inferred from the CMB by increasing the expansion rate at recombination, while the adjustments in baryon and CDM densities that keep the CMB fit unchanged lead to a lower matter fraction, thereby easing the tension with DESI BAO measurements."}
